correctness.rationale: Local inequalities define a finite poset in exact bijection with qualifying permutations. The proof establishes a greatest element below the terminal separator q and exactly 2j elements above; adding one copy forces its new tail chain and permits precisely 2j+1 insertion slots for its new top element. Induction yields double factorial for all integers m≥3,K>2m,j≥1. Independent minimal- and maximal-deletion exact programs confirm 60 instances and the separator invariant.
